Alex: Pushed a quick mock for the rollout history — trying a 'variant stack' to compress repeated versions. Screenshot attached but here's the thread. Priya: saw it, can you paste the gif? Curious about keyboard focus states. Alex: GIF uploaded (link) — main idea: stack groups same-version entries into a collapsed tile with a +n expand affordance. Visual weight reduced by 30%. Miguel: +1 on compression but a11y flag: screen readers need to know how many hidden items. Consider `aria-expanded` on the tile and `aria-live` updates when expanded. Priya: agree. Also focus order: tab should land on the tile then into the expanded list. If collapsed, pressing Enter should expand. Alex: quick ARIA snippet I tried: ```
v1.4.2 (+6)
    ...
``` Priya: good start. Use `aria-live="polite"` on the container that shows the selected version after expand so screen readers announce it. Sam: visual note: the collapsed tile's low contrast text becomes unreadable at 100% zoom. We should keep text AA contrast; maybe reduce icon weight instead of text. Alex: ok I'll lift text contrast. Also thinking about announcing rollback affordance: if a rollback happens we should toast with `aria-live` and a link to undo. Miguel: undo flow needs a persistent snackbar for at least 10s + keyboard focusable 'Undo' button. Copy suggestion: 'Rollback applied — undo' instead of 'Rollback successful'. Priya: small copy nit: in hover tooltip use 'Show versions' not 'Open' to be clearer. Alex: I'll update mocks with these changes. Any concerns about performance for very long histories (hundreds of versions)? Sam: for long lists, virtualize and limit expand to first 50 with 'show more' — same aria patterns. aria-bot: Deploy-mock-attachment added by Alex at 2025-07-15T14:22:00Z Alex: thanks all — will ship new mock by EOD, ping if anything else :rocket:
